subject.pose: Static teaching presentation, no exact paleolocality or co-occurrence claim.

source_field_map.claim_scope: Original stylized natural-process or trace-morphology teaching concept; not exact site, dated stratum or excavated specimen duplication.

distinctness.en: Closed surface funnel or collapse opening above a cavity.
distinctness.zh: 地下空洞上方形成的封闭漏斗或塌陷洞。

modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: closed surface funnel or collapse opening above a cavity. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：地下空洞上方形成的封闭漏斗或塌陷洞。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

reference_policy.scope: Child-friendly static stylized-inspired environment prop; no strict scientific reconstruction.
reference_policy.minimum_reference: Use a reliable named museum/specimen/institution or primary reference supporting recognizable basic form; existing ledger entries are retrieval leads with inherited access notes, not a new verification by this planning task. Group-only overview cannot prove a genus-specific diagnostic feature. No mandatory species/specimen matching beyond the basic form actually claimed.
reference_policy.reference_rights: Consulting facts does not require licensing a copied asset. References are consulted-only, with source URLs and actual access status retained. No reference media/scan/mesh is incorporated. If incorporating third-party media, record actual rights/license/permission first; the string consulted-only is not a third-party license grant. Prefer original geometry/maps and avoid this dependency.
reference_policy.continue_rule: Once reliable basic form and original/authorized inputs are established, proceed after the parent CI/claim gate. Do not repeatedly research or repair because color, restored soft tissue, pose, dimensions, plate/feather counts or fine reconstruction are uncertain. Label artistic choices.
reference_policy.block_only: A real basic identity contradiction, no reliable support for the named form actually claimed, unlicensed incorporated material, visibly broken proportion/connection at intended view, or failed required technical/delivery checks remains actionable. Narrow unsupported claims to the descriptive inspired-by fallback; do not invent sources or a factual PASS.
reference_policy.repair_bound: One consolidated independent QA and at most one planned cosmetic repair as the inherited practical profile specifies; persistent required defects return to parent for scope/hold decision rather than an open-ended reconstruction campaign.

scale.kind: nominal art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension; display scaling separately labeled

artistic_choices: Nominal size, palette and interpretive exposure/section/layout are artistic choices, not measured site data.
One original inventory ID counts once; color, damage, density and display revisions are not new entries.

original_criteria.description: Exact standalone GLB validates/reimports; finite geometry, units/origin and measured separate budgets; warnings dispositioned.
All eight fixed QA views and actual-GLB runtime evidence; readable distinct silhouette, credible proportions, soft natural connections at normal/near viewing scale. Counts do not certify beauty.

本次选一种封闭漏斗构图，周缘汇入中心的真实凹度及下方空腔关系可读；非karst-spring-mouth堵口或深潭无水换色。6m为名义裁片，无特定地点/塌陷事件/年代，水非必需。 Preserve original reference scope, uncertainty and representation label. No extra microscopic or precise life-reconstruction obligations.

Editable Blend, standalone GLB, deterministic generator/config and dependency hashes, bilingual metadata/scope/provenance/attribution, original small maps if used, transparent cover, eight fixed views and actual-GLB runtime evidence.
Exact GLB parsed by pinned target loader; record bounds/material/texture/errors.
Declared functional graphics runtime; identify software/hardware honestly, no unsupported physical-device performance claim.
Neutral multiple-copy teaching-prop benchmark with actual instance/work counts; no actual museum integration or cross-era habitat claim.

scientific_limits.en: Original stylized karst sinkhole teaching cutaway: an enclosed surface funnel narrows into a real open throat and an enlarged underground cavity. The artificial front subsurface section reveals rock thickness and the connection without opening the surface rim. Nominal 6 m tile, dimensions, low cover, palette and exposed section are artistic choices, not measured site, dated event, collapse sequence or hydrology. No water. The artificial front cutaway and rear-half base are not collision-ready natural cave geometry. At small hero size the throat is not fully legible; top/front views are needed to explain the internal connection.
scientific_limits.zh: 原创风格化喀斯特落水洞教学剖面：闭合周缘地表真实下凹，经窄喉连接扩大的地下空腔。人工前侧地下剖切展示岩壁厚度和空腔连接，同时保持地表漏斗周缘闭合。名义6米裁片、各部尺寸、低矮覆盖、配色及展示剖面均为美术选择，不代表实测地点、年代事件、塌陷过程或水文。无水。 人工前剖面及后半底部不是可直接用于碰撞的自然洞穴几何；小尺寸主视图不能充分显示窄喉，解释内部连接时需配合俯视和前视。

value: Nominal 6 m terrain display patch is an artistic choice, not measured site geology. This is a generic geological-form / artistic-concept model, not a dated stratum, named location, collapse history, dynamic hydrology simulation or real exposed cave face.
The front subsurface cutaway is an artificial teaching convention. Surface rim is complete; base support is intentionally rear-half only. Not a placement/collision-ready natural cave reconstruction.

Use the existing top and front views alongside the hero when explaining funnel-to-cavity identity. Every view is not required to reveal every interior feature. No camera or geometry repair is required under the frozen gates. A different optional marketing hero would be a presentation choice, not a production blocker.

At 80 px the hero communicates depression and section silhouette, not the narrow throat. The 80 px top/front pair retains the small throat/cavity signals. At 240 px regional palette and sectional cavity are more legible; at 480 px the intentional facets and quiet connections are coherent. Microscopic inspection is out of scope.

Source and raw GLB tests demonstrate a continuous air path and an enlarged lower cavity, not merely a bowl with a painted opening. Independently produced section at Y=0.137 m confirms this on actual delivered triangles.

Khronos/Three.js checks are offline parser/graph evidence. Existing eight views and 16-instance scene were inspected as exact-GLB Cycles CPU functional render evidence; not rerendered, not physical GPU/device performance and not browser acceptance.

NPS/USGS actual supplied diagram pixels were inspected. NPS supports a generic surface-depression/subsurface-void relationship; the USGS dissolution diagram alone does not establish the model cavity dimensions. All sizes, palettes, low cover and cutaway proportions remain explicitly inferred art direction. No reference image, texture, mesh or illustration is incorporated in the GLB.
Prior prepared-only freeze and c001 seam-failure history remain untouched. This acceptance applies only to c002 identity listed here and never retroactively accepts old source/failed geometry.

Blender logs include a missing optional Draco library notice despite compression explicitly disabled, and a failed user-config cache write on the read-only host. Export/reimport completed successfully; exact uncompressed GLB validated with zero Khronos/target-loader warnings/errors. These environment notices are nonblocking.
